title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_lustiges_taschenbuch_ostern_01_ecomic_sonderausg_by_walt_disney_edt9x (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_lustiges_taschenbuch_ostern_01_ecomic_sonderausg_by_walt_disney_edt9x' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone is insufficient to guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
